sources.review_notes: All 21 pages reviewed against page renders by three reviewer agents (reports/review-pages-0001-0007.md, -0008-0015.md, -0016-0021.md): equations (1)-(3) and all inline and Appendix D maths transcribed to LaTeX from the authors' TeX and compared with 220 dpi crops; Figures 1-2 checked as single composite crops; Tables 1, 2 (three parts), 3(a), 3(b), 4, 5, 6, 7 checked cell by cell; Algorithms 1-5 kept as crops with line-numbered transcriptions; 52 reference entries checked. Verifier diagnostics on pages 1-6, 8, 11 and 16-21 are LaTeX-notation, minus-glyph, algorithm-transcription and Table 7 exponent differences, adjudicated per page.
